title: 1. Full work-up (concerning)
description: Complete lab + clinical data, a flagged TB chest X-ray, and a flagged malaria blood smear - all from real held-out model test samples.
note: Composite demo case: images come from different public datasets; values are synthetic.

title: 2. Healthy screening
description: Complete lab + clinical data, an unflagged TB chest X-ray, and an unflagged malaria blood smear - all from real held-out model test samples, with negative tabular values.
note: Composite demo case: images come from different public datasets; values are synthetic.

title: 3. Partial: chest X-ray + lab only
description: Only a chest X-ray and lab values are provided - malaria, leukemia, and hypertension should all show as not assessed.
note: Composite demo case: images come from different public datasets; values are synthetic.

title: 4. Lab report only
description: Only lab values are provided - diabetes should be assessed via the lab-only model, all four other conditions not assessed.
note: Composite demo case: values are synthetic.

title: 5. Borderline values
description: Complete lab + clinical values deliberately chosen to land diabetes in the moderate (borderline) band of the combined model.
note: Composite demo case: values are synthetic, deliberately chosen near the flag thresholds.

title: 6. Clinical only
description: Only clinical values are provided (no lab) - diabetes is assessed via the clinical-only model with a low-confidence caveat, and hypertension is assessed from the same clinical profile.
note: Composite demo case: values are synthetic.
